How to Create an Account?

Click the \"REGISTER\" button on the homepage. Once you're in, just tap \"DEPOSIT\" to top up or \"WITHDRAW\" to cash out.

Can I Register More Than One Account?

Sorry, multiple accounts are not allowed. Violating this rule may result in suspension and losing all your bonuses.

Deposit & Withdraw Limits

Minimum deposit: AUD 10 Minimum withdrawal: AUD 30 Note: Deposits must be played through once before withdrawal (1x rollover).

Can I Use Someone Else’s Account to Deposit?

No. Deposits must be made from an account with the same name as your registration. Third-party payments are not accepted.

Turnover – Refers to either the minimum withdrawal or remaining balance requirements.

Rollover – Total bets placed in any game.

To protect your security, bank account changes require verification and valid documents unless the account is blocked or frozen.
